## CHARACTER SHEET

A blank character sheet for recording your adventurer's abilities, skills, equipment, and features. Print this sheet or use the [interactive character generator](https://engine.moddable.games/play/?game=dnd-5e&variant=character-sheet) to create a new character with randomised ability scores and starting equipment.
